headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team's offense. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 7-0 behind a strong performance from Sandy Alcantara. The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list. Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. The Seattle Mariners have placed Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins have placed Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, due to a left glute strain. The Cleveland Guardians have placed Slade Cecconi on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue. The Chicago White Sox have placed Chris Murphy on the 15-day injured list due to a left flexor strain and Joey Bart on the 10-day injured list due to a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand. The Toronto Blue Jays have placed Luis Urías on the 10-day injured list due to a right quad strain.

The Kansas City Royals have acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade. The Athletics have acquired right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team's offense. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 7-0 behind a strong performance from Sandy Alcantara. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer, and drove in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's injury will require a minimum 10-day absence from the team.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
